outputs.explanation: Panel A shows macroscopic photographs (bright-field and ICG fluorescence images of lungs), not a plot of averaged data.
Bar chart of mean ICG fluorescence intensity with individual data points (blue and red dots) overlaid for each mouse.
Panel C consists of micrographs (H&E, ICG, RNAscope) and spatial expression plots (heatmap-style spot plots for Cd68/Spp1), not bar/summary plots requiring individual points.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots, which are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.

Bar graph shows log2 fold-change values derived from differential expression statistical testing (Wilcoxon rank-sum across many spatial spots), not a mean of a small number of biological replicates, so individual data points are not applicable here.
Panel F shows representative fluorescence and IHC micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
